source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The MV3 test first verifies direct search and autocomplete results, terminates the background and checks the primed listener, then searches through the retained searchBook reference and awaits the new ready handshake. It finally unloads and confirms the directory is gone. Keep those separate assertions rather than using background restart alone as success. No extra promise settles merely because the listener is marked primed. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Test provider wake-up through real search and unload boundaries
